properties.name: ART On Demand (St. Lucie County)
properties.units: Port St. Lucie city; Fort Pierce city
properties.note: 3 partial zones, not full-city coverage: Zone 1 is SW Port St. Lucie only (not the whole city); Zone 2 is the St. Lucie West/Torino area, an unincorporated CDP west of Port St. Lucie with no separately mappable Census/place boundary in this tool, so it is not drawn as its own polygon here; Zone 3 is SW Fort Pierce plus the area around Treasure Coast International Airport (not the whole city). No published zone-boundary map or acreage; only named transfer points between zones (Port St. Lucie Intermodal, Bayshore Park & Ride, Jobs Express Terminal; White City Park and a Ralls Rd point in Fort Pierce). Source: https://www.stlucieco.gov/departments-and-services/area-regional-transit/our-services/microtransit

properties.name: Island Hopper
properties.note: NassauTRANSIT's Island Hopper covers the northern half of Amelia Island (fixed loop from Fernandina Beach City Hall), with Saturday on-demand service described by the operator as 'island-wide,' extending beyond Fernandina Beach city limits to unincorporated Amelia Island (e.g. American Beach). No incorporated-place or zone-size data exists for the island itself, so Nassau County is shown as an approximate proxy — actual coverage is limited to Amelia Island, not the mainland county. Sources: nassautransit.org/island-hopper/; fernandinaobserver.org, "NassauTRANSIT re-launches the Island Hopper with Saturday Island-wide service."

properties.name: VoRide
properties.units: DeLand city; Orange City city; Deltona city; DeBary city; New Smyrna Beach city; Edgewater city; Ormond Beach city; Ponce Inlet town; Daytona Beach city
properties.note: VoRide zones are named-place subsets, not full county: West Volusia covers DeLand, Orange City, Deltona, DeBary; East Volusia covers New Smyrna Beach and Edgewater (former NSB FLEX zones), Ormond Beach (north of Granada Blvd only, both beachside and mainland), Ponce Inlet (south of Dunlawton Ave, via Uber Transit), and a Daytona Beach night-service zone (excludes beachside). Zones do not connect to each other or span the full county. Source: votran.org/take-a-trip/voride.stml.
